missions.title: Stay in Position
missions.description: Tasked with both rescuing the besieged Commander and protecting the young Nytos, the recently regrouped Squad 404 has to split up again.

missions.title: Confidential Document
missions.description: Surrounded by the Military, the Commander decides to take their chances with a pistol... Meanwhile, Havier pays a visit to Persica's lab with a photograph...

missions.title: Familiar Figure
missions.description: The AR Team and M16 are finally reunited once more. M4 decides to follow her in pursuit. The two Dolls engage in yet another difficult confrontation.

missions.title: Old Friend
missions.description: Exploiting M16's momentary blunder, Dandelei establishes a connection with the OGAS in her neural cloud, enabling M4 to recover the memory fragments that were once deleted...

missions.title: Closing In
missions.description: To ensure Ange's survival, Task Force DEFY formulates a hellishly difficult operation plan... Meanwhile, in Havier's sedan, Persica reveals her secrets...

missions.title: Coda
missions.description: Task Force DEFY engages Yegor in battle. Backed into a corner, Yegor throws caution to the wind and fires missiles at DEFY from close range, but what awaits him is...

missions.title: Immemorial I
missions.description: Having failed to destroy Starfish, M16 can only watch as M4 walks into the blue light and connects with Elisa.

missions.title: Immemorial II
missions.description: Following Dandelei's suggestion, M4 destroys the connection hub and separates Elisa and Starfish by force.

missions.title: Immemorial III
missions.description: The Commander leads the surviving Dolls to the top of the base to stay out of the water's reach. Meanwhile, Ange's muzzle is trained on a dying Yegor...

missions.title: Immemorial IV
missions.description: M16 rushes to the scene but M4 and Dandelei have already completely merged with each other. Will M4 be able to keep her promise to M16...?
